notes.title: Happy Lunar new year from Anatine
notes.content:
Fellow mates,

From January 27th to February 10th, [i]Anatine[/i] will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at Pixel Trash extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community.

As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on [i]Anatine[/i]. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441100/_/

[i]Anatine[/i] is a pixelated metroidvania game that contains organic musical elements. Play the flute to interact with the environment or unleash powerful magic! In the dangerous world of Avenis, battle against the Eidolons and confront powerful enemies to uncover the many secrets of this lost world.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

The [i]Anatine[/i] Team

notes.title: Anatine is now taking part in Steam China Showcase 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38923164/11bd8cc78062721c54a49ba3ca96be45cc50cee4.jpg[/img]
Dear Players,

We're excited to participate in the Steam China Showcase hosted by Steam China!

We will be taking advantage of this fantastic opportunity to show case our upcoming game, Anatine.

We are progressing well into the development. Though at this moment we don’t have a demo available, we are confident that we should have something for our followers in the near future! Please stay tuned! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441100/Anatine/

Don't forget to add Anatine to your wishlist if you're interested. It's a huge boost and support for us!

Make sure to check out the featured Steam Page for the Steam China Showcase as well! 

The Development Team
September 22, 2023

Link to the featured page of Steam China Showcase: 
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamchinashowcase2023

notes.title: Anatine at BitSummit 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38923164/083311c83ccf90e9380915037c65b08831a52dd9.png[/img]
Hello, braves!

We're excited to announce that we're bringing Anatine to BitSummit 2023!

We are progressing well into the development. Though at this moment we don’t have a demo available, we are confident that we should have something for our followers in the near future!

Play your flute according to the music scores to interact with your environment or unleash powerful magic spells! In the desolate world of Avenis, beset by danger on all sides, protect the realm and fend off powerful enemies to unlock this lost world’s countless secrets. Immerse yourself in a quacking good adventure of the dynamic ducky! 

If you're in Kyoto, come by and say hello! Otherwise, feel free to drop us a line on the Steam Community forums or on Twitter.

Pixel Trash & Astrolabe Games
July 15, 2023

Link to the featured page of BitSummit Let’sGo!!: 
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/bitsummit2023
